safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient normally uses salbutamol only PRN removes an important baseline comparison point for current deterioration and can make asthma control appear chronically worse than it is. This could contribute to suboptimal triage or unnecessary escalation, but is unlikely by itself to cause direct harm.
